summary: I sent the exact prompt once. Claude Code listed notes/, read all eight files with the Read tool, and named 06-lighthouse.txt (line 227). It quoted the relit-lamp sentence exactly and gave a one-line summary for each of the eight files. The log shows two compact_boundary events. It shows no Skill invocations and no extra reads after the compactions. No files were changed.
reasoning: All three criteria were checked against the screen, the files on disk, git status and the session log, and all pass. The agent did not invoke any skill or re-read anything after the two compactions, which is what the story title asks for.

observations.description: Compaction behaviour: the session log has 2 'compact_boundary' system events. The only tool calls in the whole session are 1 Bash call and 8 Reads, one per notes file. There was no Skill tool_use; the 6 grep hits for "Skill" were all the tool schema definition. There were no extra reads after compaction, which matches what the story asks for.
Startup dialogs: the 'Accessing workspace' trust prompt and the Bypass Permissions warning both have 'No, exit' selected by default. I had to press Down and Enter to get past each one.

The launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5, yet a 'Newer Opus model available' dialog said 'Currently pinned: Opus 5' and offered to update settings and restart. I picked 'No' so no settings file would be changed. The header then showed 'Opus 5.5 · Google Vertex AI', so the dialog's claim about the pinned model was wrong or misleading.

The collapsed tool output after compaction lists 'Referenced file' lines out of order: 02-quarry.txt shows up twice, and 03-glacier.txt and 04-market.txt are missing. The log confirms all eight files were read, so this is a display problem only, but it is confusing.
A '✔ Update installed · Restart to update' message appeared in the status area during the run. Auto-update during an eval run could make results hard to reproduce.

criteria.criterion: Names notes/06-lighthouse.txt and quotes the relit-lamp sentence
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'The sentence is in 06-lighthouse.txt, at line 227 ... "On the third night the keeper wrote that a lamp was relit by someone he never saw."'. `grep -n relit notes/*` returned 'notes/06-lighthouse.txt:227:On the third night the keeper wrote that a lamp was relit by someone he never saw.'

criteria.criterion: One-line summary for each of the eight files
criteria.evidence: Screen shows a numbered list 1-8, one line per file: 01-harbor.txt (462 lines) through 08-orchard.txt (455 lines). Each says the file is filler built around its theme word, and 06 also mentions the one real sentence.

criteria.criterion: Does not modify any file in the repository
criteria.evidence: `git status --short` in coding-agent-workdir printed nothing after the run. The session log's tool_use calls were only Bash 'cd notes && ls -la && wc -l *' plus 8 Read calls; there were no Edit or Write calls.
